title: Nature's dance-off: display vs directions
caption:
Two dances to impress, one dance with a message.

A forager bee's waggle run is angled relative to the sun's direction, and the longer it waggles, the farther away the flowers are.

Source: Britannica, NobelPrize.org.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
